content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides the Isaiah 7:14 link by what the sign itself does or does not state, rather than weighing the competing chains by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the sign itself does not state the mechanism.","rule_words":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"\"never verse by verse\" and the retired stating-verse test: one reading forbids requiring the sign or any single witness to state the mechanism in its own words, while the other would let that silence make the link underdetermined without chain-by-footing weighing.","why":"The judge uses the sign's own silence about the mechanism as decisive, which is the verse-by-verse/stating-verse test K-C retires."}
